newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan opposition commander killed in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Afghan opposition commander killed in Pakistan.

text.p: Gunmen killed a former guerrilla commander of an Afghan opposition faction, Fazle Haq Mujahid, in the northwestern Pakistani town of Peshawar on Friday, a Pakistan-based Afghan news service reported.

It said Mujahid, an important figure in the Hezb-i-Islami party of former Afghan prime minister Gulbuddin Hekmatyar, and one of his companions were killed by unknown gunmen in Peshawar's Hayatabad neighbourhood.
There was no immediate claim of responsibility or information on the motive of the killing.
Hezb-i-Islami is a member of an opposition alliance fighting the government of Taleban Islamic militia in Afghanistan. But Afghan sources said Mujahid appeared to be sympathetic to the Taleban cause.
